title: Торговый журнал — сделки, мысли и скриншоты
author: No-Woodpecker5017
selftext:
Hello everyone, I created my own app using AI. It's a trading app designed to help you in your trading work. I'd really appreciate your feedback and suggestions on what I could improve or add.
